purpose_note: The frozen runner accepts only verification, pilot, and formal. This independent holdout uses its pilot execution mode because formal requires a committed source lock; the study phase and decision rule are specified here before launch.
statistical_unit: Training seed. Average the five paired workload-level DSR differences within each seed, then average the ten seed means. Evaluation episodes and requests are not independent training replicates.
primary_outcome: Within each seed-workload unit, DSR is deadline-satisfied service requests divided by all generated service requests over six evaluation episodes. The primary effect is the equal-weight mean of the 50 paired unit differences.
primary_uncertainty: Two-sided 95% Student-t interval on ten paired training-seed mean differences, with nine degrees of freedom.
sensitivity_analyses: Paired crossed bootstrap over training and workload seeds, 20,000 draws with seed 20260920
Pooled request-weighted DSR difference across all evaluation requests
Per-training-seed paired differences and sign consistency
decision_rule: Call the effect independently confirmed only if the primary mean difference is positive and its two-sided 95% training-seed interval excludes zero; require the crossed-bootstrap sensitivity interval to agree in direction. Otherwise report the pilot improvement as unconfirmed or uncertain. Secondary outcomes describe mechanisms and tradeoffs, without selective significance claims.
information_assumption: The upper actor can observe position, request signature, and battery state of currently unadmitted UEs within 460 m before trajectory action; physical service admission remains within 100 m.
execution_note: Use the same frozen source as the G4 pilot in a separate output directory. Do not merge or pool the interrupted Linux pilot copy with this confirmation cohort.
